scripts.dev: concurrently -n commerce,artisan -c yellow,green "npm run dev -w @sahaj/commerce" "npm run dev -w @sahaj/artisan"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:setup -w @sahaj/commerce && npm run db:setup -w @sahaj/artisan
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sahaj/commerce && npm run build -w @sahaj/artisan
scripts.start: concurrently -n commerce,artisan "npm run start -w @sahaj/commerce" "npm run start -w @sahaj/artisan"
